C-INSPECTION-SURFACE-1-2628AA2B.IntentSummary:
T2 plan for the read-only inspection surface (`C-INSPECTION-SURFACE-1-2628AA2B`), authored from the approved spec. Two query surfaces, each placed in the layer that owns its artifact: a shipped `ngrace change find|show` root (`src/grace-change.ts`, `src/query/change.ts`, renderers in `src/query/render.ts`, registered in `src/grace.ts`) and a repo-tooling `bun run record:query` (`scripts/record-query.ts`) reading through the engine's own `parseGraceXmlArtifact`, the already-exported `structuralCheck` and `derivePayerMap`. The Verdict reader (`src/gates/ledger.ts`) is extended to carry the close-evidence tally it already parses past, via the shipped `collectCloseEvidenceEvaluations`.
**What forces order, and what only looks sequential.** T-001 (the ledger reader) is a genuine prerequisite of T-002 (the verb), because `src/query/change.ts` calls `readLatestReviewVerdict` and consumes the new optional `closeEvidence` field in typed code. T-002 is a genuine prerequisite of T-004 (the selective-runner edge test reads the live `allTestFiles`, which must include `src/query/change.test.ts`). T-002 and T-003 are genuine prerequisites of T-005 (README rows and `package.json#files` name the new verb and the new `record:query` script; `test-metrics.json` must list `src/query/change.test.ts` and `scripts/record-query.test.ts`), and T-004 is a genuine prerequisite of T-005 because the regeneration must see T-004's new case in `scripts/test-affected.test.ts`. T-003 (the record query) and T-006 (the payer map) depend on nothing this bundle writes and are parallel-safe with T-001. Derived waves: `{T-001, T-003, T-006}` → `{T-002}` → `{T-004}` → `{T-005}`.
**The close's writes are in the observed scope** (`F285`, `F293`): the seven record documents the flush and `--retire` write under `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/`, `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` (the payer-map ratchet), and this bundle's own archive arrival as a glob — alongside the 17 paths the approved spec's write-scope Constraint names. `ObservedWriteScope` therefore holds 25 entries and the close-write-set check is pasted in the stage report.
**Close-time only.** Each task's `Verification` names the narrowest test file (or a `-t` slice of it). The full CI-equivalent verification runs exactly **once**, at this plan's `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` (`bun run validate:ci`) under `--assertions final --run-commands`; no task `Verification` and no `CloseEvidence` command in the bundle names `bun run test` or `bun run validate:ci`. `bun test --timeout=0` is on every invocation; no per-test timeout is introduced.
Every `AC-*` in the approved spec is close-bound, so no task carries `<Satisfies>` — a `Satisfies` of a close-bound criterion is an error, and a close-bound criterion is not a forgotten mapping. No `Clarifications` are open.

T-001.Title: Carry the close-evidence tally on the Verdict reader

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/gates/ledger.ts`: `ReviewVerdictRecord` gains an optional `closeEvidence: Array<{ criterionId: string; exit: string; result: string }>`, and `parseVerdictNode` populates it by calling the shipped `collectCloseEvidenceEvaluations` (`src/artifact/grammar.ts:2174`) — never a fresh walk of the bytes. `readLatestReviewVerdict` and `readLedgerVerdictsSurface` then surface the tally for every close-bound `AC-*` child carrying both `Exit` and `Result`.

Discriminating negatives, driven in `src/gates/core.test.ts`: a `Verdict` with no `AC-*` children yields no `closeEvidence` (absent, not an empty array dressed as present); an `AC-*` child missing `Exit` or `Result` is not reported as a recorded pass; `Finding` and `Ack` parsing is unchanged. Red direction: the new case reddens on the pre-extension reader, which returns no tally at all.
No change to `validateRunLedgerArtifact` or the on-disk `Verdict` shape: the extension is a read-side field only, and the ledger writer (`recordReviewVerdict`) is untouched.

T-002.Title: Add the ngrace change find|show root verb

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New `src/grace-change.ts` (`LINKS: M-QUERY`, `ROLE: RUNTIME`, `MAP_MODE: EXPORTS`) and `src/query/change.ts` (`LINKS: M-QUERY`); the text renderers live in `src/query/render.ts`; the root is registered on `main` in `src/grace.ts`. The house shape holds: `ngrace change find [query]` lists bundles with id, location, spec status, plan status and derived states; `ngrace change show <C-ID>` answers for a bundle in `active/` or `archive/`.

The four change-bundle answers come from the shipped readers, not a second walk: the close-bound criterion set from `collectCloseBoundCriterionIds` (`src/artifact/grammar.ts:2161`); the plan scope from `collectActiveChangeScopes` (`src/artifact/scope.ts:241`) for an active bundle and `collectAppliedChangeScopes` (`:253`) for an archived one; the per-criterion `Exit`/`Result` from the T-001-extended `readLatestReviewVerdict` plus `collectCloseEvidenceEvaluations`; the bundle location from `resolveChangeBundle` (`src/grace-cursor.ts:558`). A test asserts the printed criterion set and per-criterion tally **equal** the shipped readers' output.
Read-only: a content hash of every file under a throwaway project root is identical before and after `find` and `show`, and no path is created, deleted or renamed.

`src/query/change.test.ts` is the path-neighbour test of `src/query/change.ts`, so the selective runner maps that file conventionally. No lint code, grammar, anchor pattern, `.ngrace-lint.json` key, graph or verification anchor changes.

New `scripts/record-query.ts` (no module header, like its ungoverned siblings) with the house subcommands `find`, `show`, `check`; the record directory resolves through the engine's `resolveRecordDirWithinBoundary` (`scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:2031`) from `DEFAULT_RECORD_DIR` (`:32`) or `--record-dir`; a `record:query` package script is added in T-005, not here.

Reading goes through the engine's own surface: XML through the shared `parseGraceXmlArtifact` (`src/artifact/xml.ts`); the `check` relation through the already-exported `structuralCheck` (`scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts:1527`), which composes `genreLayerEntries`/`holdingFromDocs`/`indexOrphanFindings`; a bundle's `Pays` through the exported `derivePayerMap` (`:370`). `scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts` is **not edited**; a test asserts `check`'s finding set equals `structuralCheck`'s.

Driven both ways on throwaway record copies, never the production record: a planted index orphan reddens `check`; a planted layer mismatch reddens it; the same record with both removed is clean. `show --token` reports a retired entry **with** its `PaidBy` and a live entry with none; `show --bundle` reports the registry row's `Pays` and mints nothing while the row's name is not an archive directory. Exit contract: `find` empty 0; `show` absent non-zero; malformed record non-zero with a named reason.
Read-only: a content hash of every file in a throwaway record directory is identical before and after each subcommand, and no path is created, deleted or renamed.

T-004.Title: Map the selective runner for this bundle's src/ write set

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `scripts/test-affected.ts`'s `AFFECTED_EDGES` (`:32`) gains `src/grace-change.ts` → `["src/query/change.test.ts"]`, `src/query/render.ts` → `["src/grace-query.test.ts"]` and `src/grace.ts` → `["src/query/command.test.ts"]`; `src/query/change.ts` maps through its own path-neighbour test.

Driven in `scripts/test-affected.test.ts` against the live `allTestFiles(repoRoot)`: with `src/grace-change.ts` as the only changed file the runner selects `src/query/change.test.ts` and `fallbackToFullSuite` is false; with this bundle's whole `src/` write set changed it selects the mapped and conventional tests and does not fall back. Red direction, measured at the base: before the edges the same call falls back, because `src/grace-change.ts` has no path-neighbour test and the fail-safe at `scripts/test-affected.ts:48` sends an unmapped source to the whole suite.
The existing guard that no aggregate script or `CloseEvidence` invokes the selective runner stays green and its literal stays out of `plan.xml` and of every new artifact.

T-005.Title: Release surface: README, package metadata, CLI inventory, test metrics

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `README.md` gains an `ngrace change find` and an `ngrace change show` row in the CLI Overview plus the matching Output-modes entries; `src/query/command.test.ts`'s `liveCommandRoots` (`:837`) includes `change` and the boolean-site pin (`:772`, `:998`, `:1011`) is set to the **re-measured** count (expected 30, one `--json` per new subcommand; the value written is the measurement, never a projection). The `listLiveInvocations` test passes with the two new rows, and a planted removal of either row reddens it.

`package.json#files` gains `src/grace-change.ts` and a `record:query` script; the same exact path is added to `scripts/release-check.ts`'s `PACK_ALLOWED_EXACT` (`:113`) in the form the allowlist reader matches — exactly two leading spaces, double-quoted, a trailing comma. Driven both ways: `scripts/release-check.test.ts`'s `packed allowlist tracks package.json#files` (`:494`) is green with the entry and reddens when the entry is malformed (wrong indentation or quoting) while `package.json#files` still declares the file. `src/query/change.ts` needs no allowlist entry (it is under the `src/query/` prefix).

`test-metrics.json` is regenerated (`bun run test:metrics`) after T-001…T-004 have landed, so `scripts/test-metrics.test.ts`'s freshness relation (`:31`–`:32`) and count sum (`:33`) hold over the final file set and case counts. The artifact is a measurement, never a projected figure.

No version-synchronised file moves (`README.md`'s version line, `openpackage.yml`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `plugins/ngrace/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` stay at `6.2.0`); no skill text and no packaged skill mirror is edited; `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched.

T-006.Title: Wire the payer map for F270 and F291

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts`'s `bundleMinted` map (`:46`) gains `F270: "C-INSPECTION-SURFACE-1-2628AA2B"` and `F291: "C-INSPECTION-SURFACE-1-2628AA2B"`, and a test pins both entries to this bundle, so the post-close walk (`derived.get(token) === baseline[token] ?? bundleMinted[token]`, `:2226`) is green in the applied-archive state and a stale id reddens it.

Driven three ways on a copy of the record and the derivation: with `F270`/`F291` absent from both `baseline` and `bundleMinted` the walk's expectation is undefined (red); with a stale payer id the walk reds; with this bundle's id it is green. The registry row that makes `derivePayerMap` mint the two tokens is the close's write (Goal 6 of the spec), not this task's.
